initialExam.title: BPCL Entry Level Recruitment 2026
initialExam.description: BPCL recruits Junior Executives, Associate Executives, and Secretaries for refinery operations, marketing, finance, and HR divisions. 250 vacancies notified.
initialExam.qualifications: Diploma or Graduation depending on post
initialExam.syllabus: Aptitude, Reasoning, English, Domain knowledge based on post applied.
initialExam.examPattern: Computer-Based Test (screening) → Case-based Discussion → Group Task → Personal Interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Application Screening → Written/CBT → Case Discussion → Group Task → Interview → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Executive / Associate Executive in BPCL operations, marketing, finance, HR
initialExam.careerGrowth: Junior Executive → Executive → Senior Manager → DGM → GM → ED → Director.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit bharatpetroleum.in/careers 2. Register 3. Apply online 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: CTC approx. ₹17 LPA for entry level

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Performance bonus, Superannuation, Subsidized canteen

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
